checks.finding: The official split table is loaded before augmentation and only train rows are augmented.
Statistical descriptors are deterministic transforms and zero filtering/MI selection use the train split only in the baseline pipeline.
ZFMIS is fitted once on the complete train split before downstream GridSearchCV, so inner validation folds influence selected features.
A single checkpoint trained on train images generates features for those same training images; saved rows have no fold/checkpoint provenance.
Sigmoid calibration and threshold tuning both reuse the same validation labels and fitted validation predictions.
Many candidate configurations are evaluated on test and result/final-rule selection is sorted by test balanced accuracy.
